Payout of 8 July is short ₹1,506.00.
The bank credited ₹5,27,156.38 against an expected ₹5,28,662.38. 24 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00009 of ₹1,506.00, raised 15 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00009 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00009 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
